item.title: The Evolution and Impact of Indian Mathematics
item.description: Indian mathematics has a rich history, dating back to around 1200 BCE, with significant contributions made during its classical period by scholars such as Aryabhata and Brahmagupta. The field flourished in South Asia until the late 18th century, when it merged into a global discipline. Notable achievements include the development of the decimal number system and early studies on permutations and combinations.

item.title: India's National Archives Embarks on Ambitious Digitisation Project
item.description: The National Archives of India is undertaking a massive digitisation project to conserve and digitise over 34 crore pages of historical records, with a planned completion timeline of two years and a budget of Rs 150 crore. The project aims to preserve India's recorded history spanning over 250 years. The digitisation process is currently underway, with a large team working around the clock to scan and conserve the documents.
